items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He and Belkis were up to see Zutty one night, when Zutty was still in the band.

ctx.x: He and Belkis were up to see Zutty one night, when Zutty was still in the band. And Zutty said he was feeling so much better. He said, I sure wish I could give Marge a trip. (said she's got to be tired. She's been working so hard. Said, if I could afford it I sure would like to give her a trip.
When I took them to the door, Ertegun said, Marge, when you do get ready to take a trip let me know it's on me. Just call me and tell me wherever you want to go.
